title: Why we don't filter our honey
excerpt: Raw honey keeps the pollen and enzymes that filtering takes out.
body:
Most honey on store shelves has been filtered to make it clear and keep it from crystallizing. Filtering also strips out the pollen and enzymes that come with it from the hive.

We skip that step. Every Bogabee jar is raw: spun out of the comb and poured by hand, with the natural pollen and enzymes still in it.

If it crystallizes

Raw honey can thicken and turn grainy over time. That is natural, not spoilage. Set the jar in warm water and stir, and it turns smooth again.
